propositions: Write-op inputs (force, reason, close_class, caused_by, ref) are hand-mirrored across three adapters and experience unmechanical drift detection.

A shared conformance contract table with behavioral oracle tests each write op (transition, claim, create) across all three adapters, catching divergence through unified acceptance/rejection classification.
Runtime conditional rules (close_class required for bug-close, reason required for certain classes) are asserted behaviorally on every adapter, rejecting consistently.
Current MCP gaps (reason, caused_by, force not exposed on transition_ticket/claim_ticket) are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago, kept green in CI until closed.
Oracle reuses and extends tests/interfaces/adapters.py (Outcome + Adapter protocol) without parallel drivers; adapter-bound internals (source, repo_root) produce no false divergences.
